required.head: the commit the review covers
required.base: the commit it starts from; the ledger is named <base>.json
required.instruments: [] (array) -- one row per id in instruments.json: {id, status: applied|na, evidence|why}
required.findings: [] (array, may be absent) -- {id, summary, fix_commit, control}

control.patch: repo-relative path under .review/controls/ to a patch that REVERTS this fix
control.tests: [] -- narrow selectors. Each is run TWICE: it must PASS at HEAD, then produce a real test failure with the patch applied. A patch that breaks the build is refused, because a suite that cannot run is not a test that failed.
control.observed: what was seen when it was run by hand
